title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode7 Even So

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: The next day
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka, is that true...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We stopped receiving offers because of ReLight...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. The truth is, I ran into Mr. Hiiragi by accident over at the TV station the other day. I decided to ask him straight out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you all sooner.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's no need for you to apologize.
We get that telling us this wasn't easy for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I don't think any of us were expecting this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... If what Haruka just said is true, then there was nothing that we could've done.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That rumor about Mr. Hiiragi is one thing, and so is the fact that we don't have the backing of a big agency...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the real problem we're facing right now is that we lack the ability to fight back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
We're in a pretty tough pickle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If things end up continuing like this indefinitely...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone looks so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's figure out a way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, ReLight is a really amazing idol group... And I admit that I don't stand a chance against them right now...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the last thing we should be doing is feeling bad for ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know that turning this situation around isn't going to be easy, and I have no idea if we'll actually get more work...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I don't want us to give up...
I want us to take this opportunity to figure out a way to keep our dream of spreading hope to as many people as we can alive!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You took the words right out of my mouth.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was actually just about to say the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
I'm so sorry, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't apologize.
If anything, I'm glad you did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because now I know that you feel the same way, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We really are in a tough situation right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think I can safely say that we all want to keep spreading hope to others as idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's probably going to take us a while to come up with a good plan...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also want us to figure out a way that allows us to keep spreading hope to others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We shouldn't just dwell on our problems here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should be running straight towards our dream instead!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, and...
It's times like these when we need to remind ourselves of our ultimate goal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's keep being ourselves, inspire as many people as we can and spread more hope than any other idols out there!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start thinking about how we're going to keep spreading hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, for now, we need to work on raising our standards.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We were able to punch above our weight during Idol Lovers because we got to perform with ReLight...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to learn how to consistently perform like that—no, even better than we did that time—if we want people to invite us to their events.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start by overhauling our workout routines?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Agreed. We all excel at different things as performers, so it might be good for each of us to train with our different strengths in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll come up with some new exercises for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, we've been relying mostly on Saito to find work for us, but I'll start being more active in that department.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll try asking around as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, while you guys do that, I'll come up with stream ideas for us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Oh, speaking of which, we may also need to start rethinking our streams a bit...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As important as it is to think about our existing viewers, we have to start thinking about how we're going to get more people to start watching us.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This seems like a good list of ideas for now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... But to be perfectly honest, none of them seem like a definitive solution to get us back on our feet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it's better than doing nothing at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. This is going to be a process of trial and error. We'll try the things we talked about today, see what works and what doesn't and try to make progress bit by bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, let's do everything we can for now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I do agree with Airi...
None of these feel like they'll lead to the breakthrough we need.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we have to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We have to believe that we'll get out of this jam and keep spreading hope to others...!)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No luck again today...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Saito, Airi and I have been asking around a lot, but... It's been really rough.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I mean, people are rejecting us outright. Very few have been willing to even hear us out.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I knew this wouldn't be easy.
If this isn't working, we just need to try something else.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We just have to keep trying everything we can right now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, the others are currently practicing, so I should get changed and go work out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A visitor?
But we're not scheduled to meet anyone today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Who could it be? Wait, huh...?
se_walk_women_005_1
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ms. Arisawa...?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Hello. Do you have a minute?
